Mr.M.Shahjahan  Special Government Plead  ORDER

This Writ Petition has been filed to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing the 2nd respondent herein to consider the Appeal dated 18.06.2018 with Petition for Stay filed by the petitioner herein under Section 32 (4) (a) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 challenging the improvement Notice issued by the 3rd respondent herein in his proceedings in Na.Ka.No.826/A1/FSS ACT/2014-18 dated 04.05.2018 on merits and pass orders in accordance with law and direct the respondents 3 and 4 herein to https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ensure impartiality and transparency in implementing the Food Safety and Standards Act and consciously refrain from doing any act which would facilitate monopoly in Sago manufacturing industry and give room for manipulation of Sago market in favour of a few individuals.
2. When the matter is taken up for hearing, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the said Appeal dated 18.06.2018 was disposed of.
However, he submits that the 3rd and 4th respondents are acting impartiality against the petitioner / Sri Balamurugan Sago Industries.
Therefore, the learned counsel for the petitioner seeks appropriate instructions for the respondents to ensure impartiality and transparency in implementing the Food Safety and Standards Act.

3. On the other hand, the learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondents would submit that all the officers are acting impartiality and there is no truth in the submissions made by the petitioner.
Further he submits that the Appeal was also disposed of.

4 .
